verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe multiple stream modes (messages for token-level streaming, updates/custom for step and tool-call events, debug for full trace) with sync/async stream()/astream() iterators and separate per-projection consumption, directly matching the story of streaming tokens and intermediate events to a UI. Missing for 10: independent hands-on UI-integration examples, and a community note (langgraph-comm-4) that developers must implement significant client-side plumbing themselves rather than getting a turnkey UI streaming solution.
